name: Processor A
design_justification: Fork-with-triangle topology: node 1 is a degree-3 hub, and nodes 1-2-3 form a closed triangle. Compared with the linear-chain and branching-tree references (4 edges each), it spends one extra edge, (1,3), so that three mutually interacting qubits can be placed without a SWAP. A GHZ fan-out from a hub therefore needs fewer SWAPs on this graph than on the linear chain.
